title: Thai Sweet Pork Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired curry made with tender pork and a sweet and sour sauce.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the pork shoulder and cook until browned, then set aside.
3. In the same pan, add the remaining oil and cook the curry paste until fragrant.
4. Add the coconut milk, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, and salt. Stir well.
5. Return the pork to the pan and simmer until the sauce has thickened.
6. Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
7. Garnish with fresh herbs, such as basil or cilantro.
